name: spherical-context-qr-v1
status: prospective protocol, frozen before first run
representation: lexical hashing per supplied facet; Gaussian angular fingerprints
training: ridge relevance regression on four view-agreement features; intercept; training standardization
tuning: choose ridge penalty from [0.01, 1.0, 100.0] by validation top-1, then MRR; fixed tie order
heldout_policy: no parameter changes using test or OOD results
tokenizer: cl100k_base; count entire packet including headers; no LLM call in this experiment
limits: procedural supplied facets and explicit edges, no automatic extraction, no semantic neural encoder training, no real software execution, no infrastructure-cost or energy inference
